Problem Statement:
Write a program to check whether one array is a stack permutation of another. 
Input Description:
Given two arrays, determine if the second array can be produced by stack operations (push/pop) on the first array.
Two lines of space-separated integers.
First line: original array
Second line: target permutation 
Output Description:
true or false 
Sample Input:
1 2 3
2 1 3 
Sample Output:
true
